purpose: Curated paraphrases used to inspect extraction; neither raw passages nor automated extraction results. These are not loaded as accepted claims by default.

examples.expected_statement: The presentation illustrates an embedding model mapping objects into vectors.
The presentation illustrates similarity using mathematical distance between vectors.
The presentation describes discovery of concepts and relationships from data and marks the AI Discovery material as Coming Soon.
The proposed workflow combines AI-generated ontology suggestions with expert review before deployment.
The ARK presentation separates implemented concepts and graph-map layers from a next business-definition layer, as of its stated architecture date.
A provisional challenges slide says the graph is rebuilt daily and insights gained through use do not accumulate in that map.
The presentation describes business knowledge topics organised in a graph to route questions to required knowledge.
Its knowledge-update workflow includes review, update, regression testing and publication.
The presentation places Autonomous Database alongside AWS services in its multicloud overview.
The presentation describes property graphs over existing data in its Oracle AI Database at Azure discussion.
A JSON Relational Duality View example presents relational parts and inventory data through a JSON view and describes decoupling database changes from application changes.
The agenda includes vector-search challenges, relational-data optimisation and performance demonstrations.
A demonstration slide introduces a single-threaded baseline without an index and then with an IVF index.
The presentation connects applying recent Release Updates with obtaining security fixes.
A worked configuration shows AutoUpgrade creating a target database home for patching.
The presentation connects clinical care, enterprise operations, payer collaboration and life sciences through a shared data and AI foundation.
The disclaimer says some illustrated features concern prospective US launches, may not be offered for sale and may vary by country or region.
